turns.text: I would say 3 days ago as well.

turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, for sure. I think just because your symptoms do overlap with those of COVID, we will be doing a COVID swab today and you should hear back about your results in 24 to 48 hours.
